dz: 斯托克战地:英格兰国王亨利七世在"玫瑰之战"的最后接战中击败了约克主义叛乱的领导人.
de: Battle of Stoke Field: King Henry VII of England defeats the leaders of a Yorkist rebellion in the final engagement of the Wars of the Roses.

dz: 明胡战争：胡朝退位国王胡贵黎和他的儿子胡汉上王被明军俘虏。
de: Ming–Hồ War: Retired King Hồ Quý Ly and his son King Hồ Hán Thương of Hồ dynasty are captured by the Ming armies.

de: Yazdegerd III ascends the throne as king (shah) of the Persian Empire. He becomes the last ruler of the Sasanian dynasty (modern Iran).
